Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE measures Treasury volatility and term-premium stress: below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 113.60 is moderate. SOFR is secured overnight funding (3.88% effective Oct 2), not a stand-alone stress verdict. NFCI at -0.548 indicates looser broad financial conditions. The 10Y Treasury yield closed at 5.31%, up 3 bp from Oct 2.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today: Vice Chair Michelle Bowman at 10:45 AM ET. The FOMC minutes from Sep 15-16 arrive Wed Oct 7 at 2:00 PM ET; minutes are not a rate decision. Governor Christopher Waller is scheduled Thu Oct 8 at 4:30 AM ET.
  • Fed statistical releases: G.19 Wed Oct 7 at 3:00 PM; H.4.1 Thu Oct 8 at 4:30 PM; H.8 Fri Oct 9 at 4:15 PM; H.10/H.15 Tue Oct 13 at 4:15 PM ET.
  • Energy: EIA STEO today, heating-oil/propane update Wed Oct 7, and natural-gas storage Thu Oct 8. Weekly Petroleum Status Report shifts to Thu Oct 15 for Columbus Day, outside the week-ahead window.
  • Market structure: expanded SPX weekly expiration Fri Oct 9. Columbus Day Mon Oct 12: Fed and fixed-income markets closed/recommended closed; NYSE remains open. No separately verified timed geopolitical catalyst; unscheduled headlines remain risk.
  • Treasury coupon auctions are scheduled today-Wed: 3Y today, 10Y reopening Wed, 30Y reopening Thu. Treasury bill dates through Tue Oct 13 are shown below; pending notices remain date-only.
Omissions and Watch
  • BLS direct October schedule returned HTTP 403. The official fallback page shows Last Modified Feb 18, 2026, so freshness is uncertain; BLS events are omitted, not inferred.
  • BEA Services Supplied Through Affiliates (2024) is listed Oct 6 at 10:00 AM ET; checked and excluded as an annual structural dataset with limited immediate ES/rates sensitivity.
  • Treasury 17-week bill Oct 7, 4/8-week bills Oct 8, and 6-week bill Oct 13 appear on the official tentative schedule, but specific notices/cutoff times were not posted; retained date-only.
  • Dallas Fed Carstens policy/economy event and New York Fed conferences are date-listed without a verified public start time; omitted from timed rows. EIA petroleum status report is Oct 15, outside horizon, per its holiday-adjusted official schedule.
  • Quote snapshot is delayed and single-source (Yahoo Finance). Treasury, NY Fed, and Chicago Fed supply the 10Y, SOFR, and NFCI readings. Events at or before 12:30 AM ET were removed; no past events are repeated in the week-ahead summary.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Event risk clusters around 8:30 AM trade data, Bowman at 10:45, the noon STEO window, and Treasury auctions. ES is modestly higher overnight, while the 10Y is 5.31% and MOVE is in the moderate band. Wait for price and rates confirmation; scenario framework, not a directional call.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES breaks and holds beyond its overnight range with confirming Treasury-yield or volatility repricing, or if Bowman remarks/auction results materially shift rates. FOMC minutes Wed 2:00 PM ET are the next major policy catalyst; this is not a trade signal.
